headword: {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}
gloss: freedom of the press; press freedom

definitions.gloss: freedom of the press; the right of the media to report news without government restriction
definitions.explanation: The principle that the news media should be free to gather and publish information without censorship or interference from the government. A foundational concept in democratic societies, protected in Japan under Article 21 of the Constitution.

examples.japanese: {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Freedom of the press is fundamental to democracy.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In that country, press freedom is restricted.

examples.japanese: {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦プライバシー→プライバシー：06806_puraibashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There is debate about how to balance press freedom with the protection of privacy.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう} ranking by Reporters Without Borders (⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧なき⟦{記者|きしゃ}{団|だん}→記者団：30557_kishadan⟧) has been a topic of public debate, as Japan's ranking has fluctuated significantly. Issues cited include the press club (⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦クラブ→クラブ：10812_kurabu⟧) system, government pressure on media, and self-censorship.
